status: Prototype: early cost accepted for further qualification; not adopted

limits: Five alternating pairs per workload, synthetic keys and one process.
Mutation/copy timing includes comparison and destruction as implemented by the benchmark.
Nested-move timing excludes source creation and final validation/destruction.
Requested/container bytes exclude string-owned storage; peak counters, where reported, cover metered container allocations only, not RSS.
After-move CPU near clock resolution cannot establish a precise speedup ratio.
Candidate contents are identified by the archived headers and executable hashes; no adoption or fleet-capacity claim follows.

Five alternating pairs per workload; 100,000 actual Detent definitions with three overrides, synthetic ordered or shuffled short/max-length keys, on one Intel Mac.
CPU covers model construction, validation and destruction; this is not a publication, network, storage or end-to-end daemon benchmark.
Global ordinary and aligned C++ new counters include string-owned storage. Requested bytes exclude instrumentation headers, allocator metadata, rounding and RSS.
All samples end with zero tracked live bytes. No fleet cost or power measurement follows from these CPU results.
